snippet.title: 13Z: The Zodiac Trials Trailer
snippet.description:
A new gameplay trailer for 13Z: The Zodiac Trials - an action roguelite adventure which combines fast combat, innovative gameplay, standout visuals and culturally rich storytelling derived from Eastern fantasy lore. As revealed in the 2025 Covergence Gaming Showcase.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348250/13Z_The_Zodiac_Trials/
